steps.title: Domains and TLS
steps.subtitle: Match your public hostname to Kaneo's KANEO_CLIENT_URL.

steps.title: Reverse proxy
steps.subtitle: Point BunkerWeb at Kaneo's single port and upgrade its live-update WebSockets.

steps.title: Methods, request rate and body size
steps.subtitle: Allow the web app's own methods, load without throttling and accept the largest imports.

steps.title: Security - Real client address
steps.subtitle: Replace a client-sent X-Forwarded-For; also set TRUSTED_PROXIES on Kaneo to BunkerWeb's address only.

steps.title: HTTP - Many users behind one address
steps.subtitle: Each open tab holds two WebSockets: raise the per-address connection limit for offices and schools.

steps.title: Security - Sign-in method cookie
steps.subtitle: Kaneo's page reads its last-used sign-in method cookie from JavaScript, so that one cookie keeps HttpOnly off.

steps.title: HTTP - Large single sign-on cookies
steps.subtitle: Accept the big Cookie headers an OpenID Connect provider leaves behind. Password-only sign-in does not need this.

steps.title: Security - ChatGPT connector
steps.subtitle: Let ChatGPT's MCP connector through the user-agent blacklist. If you never connect ChatGPT, clear the field.

steps.title: Security - Bad behavior ban
steps.subtitle: The CLI and MCP sign-in poll answers 400 every 5 seconds until you approve it: stop counting 400 toward the ban.

steps.title: Security - Review text CRS exclusions
steps.subtitle: Skip injection rules for the text people write in tasks, comments, names and searches.
